screens.name: Current Status
screens.description: Google or email sign-in (identity flow), then one required current-status page. Select 11th, 12th, B.Tech, B.Sc, NEET, JEE, UPSC or Other; continue directly to personalized Home. Returning users with saved stage go directly to Home.

screens.name: Home
screens.description: Personalized social Home, upper story/status row relevant to education stage/goal, peer posts, author follow/request, like, comment, save, share, and opted-in growth proof. 15–40 status bubbles are not an initial content supply promise; horizontally scroll and show an honest empty state.

screens.name: Explore
screens.description: Search/status filters, relevant industrial experts, same-stage peers, communities, follow, private-account follow requests and accept/decline notifications. Expert verify claim must come from approved Admin/Experts system, not hardcoded badges.

screens.name: Journey
screens.description: Goal header, personal progress, tasks, weekly schedule, optional AI-editable suggestions, context-specific roadmap, evidence and project/placement preparation; NEET/JEE users receive preparation-appropriate cards instead of B.Tech-only milestones.

screens.name: Chats
screens.description: Inbox tabs All/Peers/Experts/Groups, real unread counts, conversation/message previews, notifications and server-side block/report/request state. Adult–minor private expert messaging is restricted until approved policy.

screens.name: Profile
screens.description: Profile header, bio, posts, followers/following/connections, own achievements, saved/activity tabs, status switch, edit/create post and personal Career Growth summary linked to Journey.

scopeExclusions: No backend REST routes inferred from screenshot
No new service/table/event without CGN-290 sign-off
No unverified employers or expert badges used as real identity
No forced peer following or unrestricted adult-minor DM
